items.title: Show HN: Full Python 3.15 Implemented in 25k LoC C11
items.contentSnippet:
I burned about $500 for this fun project: Small Python.
Initial PoC used 3 resets of Codex in one session but all later development happens in Claude Code, also in one Opus 5.5 session over three days.
The outcome is a quickjs-like implementation for Python.
Almost full Python 3.15 language features plus builtins are covered.
No Lib/  support.
Great for embedding scenarios.
No rust. Just plain C11 code.
Repo is here: https://github.com/soasme/small-python/
Ask me anything.

A complete money universe is constructed directly from itemized FEC transactions, 2008 to today.
Elections go all the way back to 1788; who won every seat, with vote counts since 1976 (presidential since 1828).
Bills, actions, and other legislative metadata go back to 1975 and roll-call votes to 1989 (as far as the public sources go).
